# Book: The Signal
## Reader
Readers of short stories.
Not for: readers seeking a manual.
## Premise
Two neighbours try to identify a signal.
## Cast
- Nora (30): technician who wants quiet.
- Jonas: neighbour who wants an answer.
## World
A present-day town; radios follow ordinary physical rules.
## Arc
A signal arrives, the neighbours investigate, and they find its source.
## Hooks
- Title: “The Signal”
- Opening: A radio wakes Nora.
## Voice
POV: third person
Tense: past
- Avoid: "miraculous solution"
